scope: Nushima island envelope [134.805,34.15,134.84,34.185]. Catalogued GSI maps, imagery, terrain, land conditions, hazard portal and evacuation sites; 16 relevant MLIT national-land dataset families were inspected. This is a dated coverage audit, not a claim that every government dataset or historical edition has been exhausted. MAFF 2023 Fisheries Census community boundaries were additionally imported for official Nushima district 261.

maff.publisher: Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries (MAFF), Statistics Department
maff.dataset: 2023 Fisheries Census fishing-community boundaries (漁業集落境界)
maff.processing: Selected official Nushima district by attributes; transformed JGD2011 to WGS84; repaired geometry; grouped the two other-area records by official KEY into one multipart feature. Preserved source attributes. No clipping, simplification or invented boundaries. Added display names, census year, category labels and colours.

rasterCoverageMethod: HTTP status and nontransparent image pixels for every z14 tile intersecting the island envelope; a successful tile is not a guarantee that every point is covered. Visually inspected the imagery and thematic samples.

processing.method: Transform from source CRS to EPSG:4326; repair invalid geometry; intersect island envelope; preserve source attributes; round to 7 decimals. N09 retains full routes whose attributes name Nushima. Sea class 1500 excluded from land-use display. No geometry simplification.

unavailableNotes: GSI English basemap, orthophoto (ort), 1961–1969 / 1945–1950 imagery, gazo2–4, annual imagery except 2020/2021, initial land-condition map and flood-control landform tiles had no nonempty samples in this envelope.
River flood and landslide warning (jisuberi) tiles had no nonempty samples. This is not evidence of no hazard.
MLIT medical/school/transport records retain their publication years and are not live service directories.
MLIT C02 harbour, P14 welfare and any other zero-feature extracts remain documented in the processing audit rather than appearing as empty switches.
GSI relief marine data uses Japan Coast Guard Hydrographic and Oceanographic Department materials.
MLIT C23, C09, N09 and P20 are supplied under non-commercial terms; attribution and restrictions remain attached to each layer.

nativeZoomChecks.sampleMethod: Tile containing a nontransparent published z14 hazard pixel

nativeZoomCheckMethod: Checked maximum native zoom at 134.821E, 34.168N; debris-flow coverage additionally verified at a nontransparent z14 hazard pixel. HTTP/image checks do not establish complete spatial coverage.
